name: read_symbol
description: MUST READ BEFORE WRITE. Symbol body + version (base_version for writes). Resolves by symbol_id or name+file. Full file? read_outline. AUTO-FRESH: files modified after last index are re-indexed automatically on read — explicit reindex only needed for brand-new workspaces/files.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

name.description: Symbol name (used with file_path when symbol_id unknown)

line_range.description: Degraded line_range read for non-code files: [start, end] 1-based inclusive

name.description: Symbol name (used with file_path when symbol_id unknown)

line_range.description: Degraded line_range read for non-code files: [start, end] 1-based inclusive

locators.description: Y002-S5 batch entry: array of locators, parallel read-only, per-entry failure non-blocking. Use instead of locator for multi-symbol reads.

context_lines.description: Context lines around symbol (default 0 — context_lines does not affect slicing; symbol body is returned as indexed)

include_outline.description: Force include file outline (off in core by default)

budget_hint.description: Max body chars to return; must truncate, not hint (default 1200)

source.description: live (default): current file+staleness. indexed: read-only snapshot, never for write.

on_ambiguous.description: fail (default): return candidates, never silently pick.
